info.name: TIBCO Mashery API Management Rest API
info.description:
API management platform for designing, building, securing, and analyzing APIs. The Mashery V3 API provides programmatic access to manage API definitions, packages, plans, keys, services, endpoints, and analytics data within the TIBCO API management platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: TIBCO Support
